notes.title: Major Update:Complete UI Overhaul and Optimization/Room Grouping Functi
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44421306/e87d7658707cd16f9666550c833bbda7eafef294.jpg[/img]
It's been a while! Thank you all for your feedback and patience. This update focuses on enhancing the gaming experience with a comprehensive overhaul and optimization of the UI, alongside the launch of the room grouping functionality, making ground management more convenient and flexible for players. We also plan to continue refining the user experience and adding new content for the official version in the future, so stay tuned.

[h2]Complete UI Overhaul and Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fully redesigned main interface and desktop logo
[*]Improved blueprint interface animations and optimized feature display
[*]Enhanced gameplay interface animations with partial design improvements
[*]A series of other interface updates
[/list]
[h2]Room Grouping Functionality[/h2]
[list]
[*]Room groups can now be selected in the blueprint interface
[*]Floors within the same group will automatically link together in the blueprint

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44421306/4388d13e9828b3f0037b84590e94c0a5f9509c19.gif[/img]
[*]Group content can be uniformly deleted in the blueprint
[*]Floor materials for different groups can be set separately

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44421306/8e6d29918d9f6c753f44b3ef4877ab6c60273a5b.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]Floor Material Drawing Method[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed from direct replacement to mouse click selection
[/list]
[h2]Automatic Cloud Saves[/h2]
[list]
[*]Steam Cloud Save functionality is now supported
[/list]

notes.title: CozySpace Update v1.03.503
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44421306/8e56c61fe8658f15f321604201d35a15efeda009.jpg[/img]


[h1]Happy Chinese New Year![/h1]

[h2]New content[/h2]

This update includes a series of furniture and small decorations with a Chinese New Year's atmosphere. Players can now enter the game after the update to check them out.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where players couldn't place chairs near bunk beds.
[*]Fixed the problem where using both the scrollbar and drag points simultaneously resulted in incorrect model scaling.
[*]Fixed the issue where objects already snapped to walls couldn't be placed when dragging to scale.
[*]Fixed the problem where decorations couldn't be placed on walls at certain angles (e.g., 45 degrees).
[/list]


We appreciate everyone's support and company. In the future, we will bring more updates and optimizations to everyone!

notes.title: Major update: Multiple rooms and irregular rooms are now supported.
notes.content:
[h1]Update Notes - November 17, 2023[/h1]


Hey guys!
We are thrilled to announce that the much-anticipated Multi-Room and Irregular Room Blueprint features are now live and available for everyone after the recent update.
Players can now open the Blueprint feature after updating the game, allowing them to create more freely designed room layouts.

[list]
[*]Added support for Multi-Room and Irregular Room layouts.
[*]Introduced real-time polygonal lighting based on LTC for a more realistic indoor lighting effect.
[*]Optimized the furniture placement with improved magnetism.
[*]Added a floating feature, lifting collision restrictions and unlocking the Y-axis height for flexible furniture placement.
[*]UI now accommodates resolutions such as 5:4, 4:3, 21:9, etc.
[*]Added a save file copy function.
[*]Fixed a bug related to the favorite sorting in the wallpaper and flooring lists.
[/list]

Once again, we appreciate your support for our spatial design endeavors,We are continuously working on optimizing and adding new features. 
Stay tuned for future updates on the Workshop and UI enhancements. We believe these features will be available for everyone in the near future!

notes.title: CozySpace Update v1.01.209
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44421306/3cac4049725677fa1584d1b22aa2e76b20bec398.jpg[/img]

[h1]Happy Mid-Autumn Festival to all the gamers in the entire universe!
[/h1]
[h1]Update Notes - September 25, 2023[/h1]

1. In this update, we've introduced a "Street Food Market" themed furniture series, featuring elements like Mid-Autumn mooncakes, lanterns, and of course, everyone's favorite plastic chairs and stools.

2. Added furniture size indicators. You can now enable or disable the size indicators by clicking the "Ruler" icon in the bottom right corner.

3. Altered the behavior when moving furniture. Now, furniture doesn't immediately snap to the cursor's position after clicking to move it. This change aims to allow players to more precisely fine-tune the placement of their furniture.

4. Improved the display logic of the base frame to better accommodate model rotations and scaling.

5. Optimized texture loading methods, reducing memory usage during gameplay.

6. Made minor adjustments to the idle animations of the animals.

notes.title: CozySpace Update v1.01.001
notes.content:
[h1]Free camera/Orthographic view[/h1]

We have added a free camera in the perspective into the game, which allows players to switch angles at will in the perspective to better arrange the room! At the same time, an orthogonal perspective is added, allowing players to preview their rooms under different perspective logic.

R: Switch perspective/orthographic view
Q/E: Infinity rotating room
space: Return to the perspective


[h1]Adsorption logic adjustment[/h1]

The adsorption logic has been modified, and the original too precise grid adsorption has been changed to wall adsorption. Most of the current furniture can be placed against the wall.


[h1]Bug fixes and modifications[/h1]

1. Fixed the error where a window created in blueprint mode would turn into a door after entering the game.
2. Adjusted the appearance time of mouse hover prompts.
3. Optimized the display effect of the racing simulator screen.

Thank you again for your support and companionship!

notes.title: CozySpace Update v1.00.205
notes.content:
September 4, 2023 Update

1. Enhanced rainy and snowy weather effects.
2. Added a few new models. (Yes, Cola is here!)
3. Introduced blocks that can adhere to walls.
4. Added a screen toggle, allowing players to choose whether to turn the screen on or off.
5. Adjusted the reflections of different material floors.
6. Fixed an issue where material copying and furniture income were not recorded.
7. Added brief text descriptions when hovering over with the mouse.
8. Modified material channel labels from numerical values to previews of the current material or color. This change aims to provide players with a more intuitive understanding of the represented channel.
9. Optimized and standardized some game interaction logic.

Due to our limited team size, our primary focus in the future will be on adding new features, including multiple rooms, irregular rooms, free-moving perspectives, and pet models, and addressing critical bugs to avoid diminishing the player experience. Logic optimization and UI beautification will also be tackled as secondary priorities. Your feedback remains invaluable, and we greatly appreciate your support.

Quick Tip: As developing multiple rooms and irregular rooms is a significant task that requires time, we have added blocks in the main interface, allowing players to place and deform them within rooms to serve as walls or partitions.

notes.title: Minor Update v1.00.100
notes.content:
Update on August 23, 2023:

1.The blueprint interface now includes a button to return to the main page.
2.We have added an automatic backup list to each room, aiming to minimize potential losses in case of accidental item deletion or removal, allowing players to recover from such incidents.
3.Fixed an issue where dragging an object to the music bar and left-clicking to place it would delete the selected object and trigger the music control system.
4.Addressed a problem where track volume settings were not being saved according to the room.
5.Resolved an issue where, after selecting and moving an object to a new location, right-clicking the mouse to cancel placement would not return the object to its original position, but rather place it at the mouse's current location.
6.Fixed several bugs that could lead to furniture disappearing suddenly.
7.Fixed a bug where rotating furniture could result in a tilted appearance.
8.Corrected an issue where inputting certain RGB values, such as "WASD," in the color modification panel would cause unintended room movements in different directions.
9.Fixed a problem where main volume settings in the configuration interface and vertical synchronization settings were not being properly recorded.
10.When furniture cannot be placed, the corresponding bottom frame will turn red.

We have carefully reviewed and taken into consideration every piece of feedback from players. Your voices are heard, and we appreciate your valuable input.

Due to time and resource constraints, the initial release unfortunately had areas that needed improvement and optimization. In the future, we plan to regularly introduce new models and creatures, aiming to present irregular rooms to everyone as soon as possible. We will also continue to enhance the logic of furniture attachment and interaction, striving to make the attachment feature more intuitive while efficiently adding new models. There are many more ideas we wish to implement and share for your enjoyment, so please allow us some more time!
